title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Add a collection of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling examples, and four quickstarts intended for the docs site and redwood-examples. Motivation: provide first-class starter templates for engineers integrating RAG + agent patterns with Redwood's tool-calling APIs and to reduce onboarding friction for feature teams. The PR includes: - RAG agent templates (python + ts) with configurable retriever adapters (vectorstore, semantic similarity) - Tool-calling examples demonstrating structured tool spec usage and function-like invocations from chat responses - Quickstart walkthroughs (Create index -> wire retriever -> deploy agent) for docs site with screenshots and code snippets - Minor docs site layout change to surface Agents quickstart in the sidebar Checklist: - [x] Add runnable examples to redwood-examples/agents - [x] Add docs pages and frontmatter for quickstarts - [x] Add CI doc-tests for code snippets - [x] Run docs lint and spellcheck Notes: kept code examples concise; long-running indexing jobs are mocked in examples and call out production sections. See related PRs: pr-25510 and pr-25012. Linear tickets: ENG-4281 (RAG quickstarts), DOC-312 (docs site nav), PM-210 (product review).

pr_body_summary: This PR introduces beginner-friendly RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts to streamline developer onboarding for retrieval + agents workflows. Examples are runnable, use an in-repo vectorstore mock by default, and the docs site has a new Agents quickstarts section in the sidebar.
